name: monday.com Ltd.
summary: monday.com Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops software applications in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company provides Work Operating System (Work OS), a cloud-based visual work OS that consists of modular building blocks used and assembled to create software applications and work management tools.
